comment: SHA-256 pin for the runtime vendor artifacts (supply-chain integrity, not provenance). scripts/fetch-vendor.mjs refuses to use or re-download a file that does not match this lock, and packages/plugin/build-client.mjs inlines only files recorded here. The genuine artifact is the hash recorded here; anything else is a corrupted or tampered download. pixi/display are committed (MIT); both Live2D Cubism cores are NOT committed, they are fetched only after the Live2D EULA is accepted.
update: Review the upstream change first, then run: node scripts/fetch-vendor.mjs --accept-live2d-eula --update-lock

core2.source: community mirror https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/dylanNew/live2d/webgl/Live2D/lib/live2d.min.js (Cubism 2 Core; only needed for Cubism 2 models)
